correctness.rationale: On the full 27-dimensional product-sphere tangent space, use the 20 strict square-edge × pentagon-edge facets and the signed bivector formula 24V=<A_square,*A_pentagon>. The exact spherical chart supplies the quadratic deficit (b/24)[5Σ||X_i||²+4Σ||Y_j||²+4Σ(u_i·Y_j)(v_j·X_i)+(5/2)Σ(Δα)²+2Σ(Δβ)²]. Tight-frame decomposition X_i=Ku_i+R_i and Y_j=Lv_j+S_j converts the mixed block to ten||K+L^T||_F² and decouples residuals. Square and pentagon cycle-Laplacian Fourier eigenvalues yield coefficient levels 0×6, b(5−√5)/24×2, b/6×6, 5b/24×6, b(5+√5)/24×2, 3b/8×4, 5b/12×1 (27 total). All six null modes are rigid rotations. The compact O(4)-orbit slice and O(||z||³) Taylor error give sharp local Δ/d² lower limit μ=b(5−√5)/24, attained by pentagon first harmonic. The inspected verify.py and independently computed finite-difference Hessian corroborate, but do not replace, analytic signed pairing and tight-frame diagonalisation.
residual_risks: Local facet persistence needs strict supporting inequalities, not just a combinatorial hypothesis; the support hyperplanes are strict at the reference configuration.
The reference global maximality theorem is imported, not reproved; claims make no global quadratic lower bound.
